properties.description: Moon (2009), directed by Duncan Jones and starring Sam Rockwell, Kevin Spacey and Dominique McElligott, is a low-budget, near-future science fiction drama that blends psychological mystery with emotional character work. The film emphasizes intimate performances, practical production design, and a meditative tone to explore loneliness, family longing and ethical questions about cloning and exploitation.

properties.description: Moon (2024), directed by Kurdwin Ayub and starring Florentina Holzinger, Celina Sarhan and Andria Tayeh, is an Austrian crime-drama-thriller that blends sports elements with art-house sensibilities. properties.description: Moonlight (2016), directed by Barry Jenkins and featuring Mahershala Ali, Naomie Harris, and Trevante Rhodes, is a three-part coming-of-age drama about a young Black man growing up in Miami. The film traces the protagonist's development from childhood through adulthood as he confronts poverty, a drug-addicted parent, bullying, and emerging sexual identity. Its restrained performances, vivid use of color, and episodic structure foreground themes of identity, masculinity, mentorship, and belonging. The result is a quietly powerful, emotionally resonant portrait of self-discovery.

properties.description: Moonstruck (1987), directed by Norman Jewison and written by John Patrick Shanley, is a romantic comedy-drama starring Cher, Nicolas Cage and Olympia Dukakis. The result is a warm, bittersweet picture that balances comic humanity with romantic passion.

properties.description: Arrival (2016), directed by Denis Villeneuve and based on a short story by Ted Chiang, stars Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner, and Forest Whitaker in a contemplative science-fiction drama. Its tone is melancholic and cerebral, balancing suspense with moving, thought-provoking ideas.

Its emotional core and monumental visuals create a contemplative, often moving experience.

Mysteries of the Solar System...

Grab Your Intergalactic Hiking Gear!

properties.description: Moon (2009), directed by Duncan Jones and starring Sam Rockwell, Kevin Spacey and Dominique McElligott, is a low-budget, near-future science fiction drama that blends psychological mystery with emotional character work. The story follows an astronaut on a three-year solo stint at a lunar mining base who begins to experience hallucinations and ultimately discovers a duplicate of himself, provoking an investigation into memory, identity and corporate practices. The film emphasizes intimate performances, practical production design, and a meditative tone to explore loneliness, family longing and ethical questions about cloning and exploitation.
properties.plot_summary: An astronaut nearing the end of a three-year solo contract on a lunar mining base begins experiencing hallucinations and memory disorientation while working with the station's robotic assistant. After a rover accident he wakes to find evidence that his situation is not what it seems, and an identical man at an exterior harvester forces him to confront the truth about his identity and the company he serves. The discovery triggers a tense, intimate struggle to piece together stolen memories, confront corporate exploitation, and find a way home.

properties.description: Arrival (2016), directed by Denis Villeneuve and based on a short story by Ted Chiang, stars Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner, and Forest Whitaker in a contemplative science-fiction drama. A linguist is enlisted to communicate with twelve mysterious extraterrestrial vessels and, in the process, decodes an alien language that reshapes perception of time and memory. The film interweaves a procedural first-contact narrative with intimate emotional stakes, exploring themes of communication, grief, fate, and international tension. Its tone is melancholic and cerebral, balancing suspense with moving, thought-provoking ideas.
properties.plot_summary: When twelve enormous extraterrestrial vessels appear at locations around the globe, linguist Louise Banks is recruited to lead a small team charged with establishing communication. As international tensions rise and military leaders fear hostile intent, she works to decode the visitors’ complex written language and uncover their purpose. Learning to think in the visitors’ non-linear terms alters her perception of time and memory and forces her to confront personal loss. The film balances procedural first-contact investigation with intimate emotional stakes and philosophical questions about communication, fate, and grief.

properties.description: Interstellar (2014), directed by Christopher Nolan and co-written with Jonathan Nolan, is an adventure-drama starring Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway and Jessica Chastain that blends hard science-fiction with a human family story. As Earth's environment collapses, a former pilot leads an expedition through a wormhole to seek new worlds, confronting relativistic physics, moral dilemmas, and enormous personal sacrifice. The film foregrounds themes of survival, parental bonds, love transcending time, and the tension between scientific vision and political short-sightedness. Its emotional core and monumental visuals create a contemplative, often moving experience.
properties.plot_summary: As Earth succumbs to crop blight and massive dust storms, a former NASA pilot turned farmer is recruited to lead a mission through a recently discovered wormhole to search for habitable worlds. The expedition confronts extreme scientific obstacles, relativistic time effects, and morally wrenching choices as candidate planets are evaluated. Interwoven with the interstellar quest is a deeply personal story about a father's bond with his daughter, and the sacrifices demanded by the attempt to secure humanity's future.

properties.style_description: A restrained, retro-futuristic visual approach that blends practical, analog production design with moody, intimate cinematography to emphasize isolation and human scale.

properties.description: Mass Effect is a science-fiction action role-playing game in which the player, as humanity's first major representative on the galactic stage, must investigate and thwart an ancient, galaxy-spanning threat while recruiting allies, making consequential moral choices, upgrading talents, customizing weapons and vehicles, and exploring numerous uncharted planets with side quests and discoveries.

short_descriptions.value: As humanity's first galactic envoy, you uncover a looming existential threat and must persuade others and gather allies to prevent the extinction of civilization.
Als erster menschlicher Vertreter in der Galaxis entdeckst du eine existenzielle Bedrohung und musst andere überzeugen sowie Verbündete sammeln, um die Zivilisation zu retten.
Como el primer enviado humano en la galaxia, descubres una amenaza existencial y debes convencer a otros y reunir aliados para evitar la extinción de la civilización.
En tant que premier envoyé humain galactique, vous découvrez une menace existentielle et devez convaincre les autres et rallier des alliés pour sauver la civilisation.

properties.description: Outer Wilds is an open-world exploration mystery in which the player explores a small solar system trapped in a repeating time loop, investigating extinct civilizations, planetary hazards, and hidden secrets to uncover why the loop exists.

short_descriptions.value: Explore a solar system trapped in an endless 22-minute time loop to uncover its mysteries before time resets.
Explorez un système solaire pris dans une boucle temporelle de 22 minutes pour percer son mystère avant que le temps ne se réinitialise.

Explora un sistema solar atrapado en un bucle temporal de 22 minutos para desvelar su misterio antes de que el tiempo se reinicie.
